segments.vv77:1.3: Kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā, veḷuriyathambhā rucakatthatā subhā.
segments.vv77:2.1: “Tatthacchasi pivasi khādasi ca, dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ;
segments.vv77:2.3: Dibbā rasā kāmaguṇettha pañca, nāriyo ca naccanti suvaṇṇachannā.
segments.vv77:3.1: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv77:4.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv77:5.1: “Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto, vivane pathe saṅkamanaṃ [caṅkamanaṃ (sī.), caṅkamaṃ (syā.), samakaṃ (ka. sī.)] akāsiṃ;
segments.vv77:5.3: Ārāmarukkhāni ca ropayissaṃ, piyā ca me sīlavanto ahesuṃ;
segments.vv77:5.5: Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
segments.vv77:6.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

lines: Ārāmarukkhāni cā ārāmabhūte rukkhe, ārāmaṃ katvā tattha rukkhe ropesinti attho.
